summary: Iteration 13: Tested new features - BrunoWebsite marketing page (/website, /bruno routes), WelcomeTour component, and CardPicker for chat. Fixed bug in MessageAttachment model that was dropping card-specific fields. Fixed CardMessagePreview to handle attachment field naming correctly.

fixed_in_this_iteration.issue: Card messages were not storing card-specific fields (card_id, card_title, card_subtitle, card_type, primary_color, secondary_color)
fixed_in_this_iteration.fix: Added card-specific fields to MessageAttachment model in server.py

integration_issues.issue: Navigating to /chat sometimes redirects to login - appears to be intermittent auth state issue in Playwright tests (known issue from iteration 12)
integration_issues.note: Auth API works correctly via curl. This appears to be a browser session/localStorage persistence issue in automated tests.

fixed_in_this_iteration.issue: Component was using card.type/card.title/card.subtitle but attachment stores as card_type/card_title/card_subtitle
fixed_in_this_iteration.fix: Updated to support both field naming conventions

critical_code_review_comments: BrunoWebsite.jsx (542 lines) - Well structured marketing page with all sections: nav, hero, features, pricing, store, testimonials, CTA, footer
WelcomeTour.jsx - Good implementation with 9 tour steps, localStorage persistence per user ID, auto-show for new users within 1 hour
CardPicker.jsx - Modal for selecting cards to share in chat, CardMessagePreview for rendering shared cards in messages
App.js correctly integrates TourProvider wrapping the router and TourOverlay rendered at app level

success_rate.backend: 100% - Card messages now store all fields correctly
success_rate.frontend: 90% - Website pages working, tour component exists, card picker API works

seed_data_creation: Sent test card messages to existing chat 52772b5a-e01c-454f-abf3-ce4b51fc1866
context_for_next_testing_agent: BrunoWebsite verified working at /website and /bruno routes. Card message sharing via CardPicker now works correctly. Welcome Tour component exists and is integrated but doesn't auto-show for existing test user (only shows within 1 hour of account creation).

bruno_website_routes.details: Marketing page loads with all sections: navigation (Funciones, Precios, Tienda, Contacto), hero section, 6 feature cards, 3 pricing plans (Gratis/Pro/Empresa), store preview, 3 testimonials, CTA, footer

welcome_tour_component.details: TourProvider integrated in App.js, TourOverlay rendered at app level. 9 tour steps covering cards, feed, chat, map, store, points, notifications. Auto-shows for new users within 1 hour.

card_picker_component.details: Modal opens from attach menu in chat, lists user's cards with search, sends card messages with all metadata preserved

card_message_in_chat.details: Now correctly stores card_id, card_title, card_subtitle, card_type, primary_color, secondary_color in attachments

backend_fix.issue: Card messages were not preserving card-specific fields in attachments
backend_fix.root_cause: MessageAttachment model only had generic fields (type, url, filename, etc.) but no card-specific fields
backend_fix.fix_applied: Added card_id, card_title, card_subtitle, card_type, primary_color, secondary_color fields to MessageAttachment model
backend_fix.verification: Tested via curl - card messages now return all fields in attachment

frontend_fix.issue: CardMessagePreview component couldn't read card type and title from attachment
frontend_fix.root_cause: Component expected card.type/card.title but attachment uses card_type/card_title naming
frontend_fix.fix_applied: Updated component to support both naming conventions: cardType = card.card_type || card.type
frontend_fix.verification: Code review confirms fix handles both direct card objects and attachment objects

web_push.details: Backend stores subscriptions but doesn't send actual push notifications
